entries.category_description: Foodstuffs (including beverages but excluding alcoholic beverages) for human and animal consumption; live animals, seeds, plants and ingredients normally intended for use in the preparation of foodstuffs; products normally used to supplement foodstuffs or as a substitute for foodstuffs
entries.code_description: Bread, not containing added honey, eggs, cheese or fruit, and containing by weight in the dry matter state not more than 5 % of sugars and not more than 5 % of fat
entries.comment: From July 1, 2026, the tax rate of 4.9% applies to the foodstuffs listed in Annex 3 to Sec. 10 of the Austrian VAT Act 1994. Please note, among other things, that the reduced tax rate of 10% continues to apply to CN subheadings 0703 1011, 0709 5400, 0709 5500, and 0709 5600.

entries.category_description: Pharmaceutical products of a kind normally used for health care, prevention of illness and as treatment for medical and veterinary purposes, including products used for contraception and sanitary protection

entries.comment: This reduced rate applies only to food for special medical purposes within the meaning of the Food Act.
